questions.stem: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.misconception: invents a sound link not present
invents a sound link not present

questions.explanation: The pun plays on 'ceiling' sounding like 'sealing,' a cap on costs. The key is C, "'Ceiling' echoing 'sealing,' a cost cap".
